ghs.assessment: 'Stocks market' is an ungrammatical noun phrase; the Japanese simply calls him a defeated stock trader.
ghs.remedy: Use 'Stock-market loser!'

highlights.text: Tomoki: "Stocks market loser!"

rows.jp: 「かかか株のことは言うなー！！」

ghs.en: Taichi: "St-st-st-stocks are out of bounds!!!"
Kiri: "Are they having a falling out?!"
Miyuki: "Ahhh, ahhh..."

rows.jp: 「おまえだって人のこと、シスコンオナニーのプロとかあちこちで吹聴しただろ！」
rows.en: “You went all over the school telling people I was a pro at jerking off to my sister!”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "You went and told everybody left and right of how some people are 'pro-level siscon onanists', didn't you!"
ghs.assessment: The source says that Taichi spread the claim that Tomoki himself was a professional siscon masturbator. 'Some people' removes the directly targeted person and weakens the accusation.
ghs.remedy: Use 'You went around telling everyone I was a professional siscon masturbator!'

highlights.text: Tomoki: "You went and told everybody left and right of how some people are 'pro-level siscon onanists', didn't you!"

rows.jp: 「ああ言ったさ！　特に女の子に言ったさ！　皆もう大喜びさ！」
rows.en: “I did! I made a special point of telling the girls! They were all delighted!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yeah I said it! I said it especially to girls! And everybody's so very happy for you!"

rows.jp: 「あれからたまにプロとか呼ばれるようになったんだぞー！」
rows.en: “Ever since then, people sometimes call me ‘Pro’!”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "And since then every once in a while someone calls me a 'pro' and that stuff!"
Taichi: "It's a fact!"
Tomoki: "What I said's a fact too!"
Taichi: "Dammiiit!"
Tomoki: "What nooow!"
SlapSlapSlapSlap!!!
And then,
we self-destructed.
Tomoki: "Ngggh..."
Taichi: "Ghhh..."

rows.en: There we lay, flat on our backs in the hall.

ghs.en: The two of us lie on our back in the hallway.

rows.en: “...Should I take you to the nurse's office?”

ghs.en: Miyuki: "...do you need to go to the infirmary?"

rows.en: “Wh-what happened to our champion of justice?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Wh-, what about that Champion of Justice of earlier?"

rows.jp: 「佐倉霧。正義の味方じゃない」
rows.en: “Kiri Sakura. And I’m not a champion of justice.”

ghs.en: Kiri: "Sakura Kiri. I'm not a Champion of Justice."

rows.jp: 少女は俺たちを見下しながら言った。
rows.en: The girl spoke while looking down at us.

ghs.en: So she said while looking down on us.

rows.jp: 「……そしてあなたたちも、悪なんて美意識のあるものじゃないことがわかった」
rows.en: “...And now I see you two don’t even qualify as evil. Evil has taste.”

ghs.en: Kiri: "...furthermore, you have understood that evil has no sense of beauty."
ghs.assessment: The speaker says she has realized that the two people before her are not even something as aesthetically principled as evil. The English instead says that they have understood a general claim that evil lacks beauty, reversing subject and evaluative relation.
ghs.remedy: Use '...And now I see that neither of you possesses enough aesthetic sense even to qualify as evil.'

highlights.text: Kiri: "...furthermore, you have understood that evil has no sense of beauty."

rows.jp: ぶわっと友貴が滂沱(ぼうだ)する。

ghs.en: With a sudden Tomoki explodes in a torrent of tears.

rows.jp: 「ぼ、僕は関係ないのに。太一のせいで僕まで……」
rows.en: “I-I had nothing to do with it. Because of Taichi, now I'm...”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "I-, I have nothing to do with this! It's Taichi's fault, always making me..."
ghs.assessment: The dragged-in complaint remains. Only always is unsupported.
ghs.remedy: Remove the unsupported frequency claim.

highlights.text: Tomoki: "I-, I have nothing to do with this! It's Taichi's fault, always making me..."

rows.jp: 友貴はカブトの幼虫みたいに丸くなった。
rows.en: Tomoki curled up like a rhinoceros beetle larva.

ghs.en: Tomoki huddles over until he looks as round as the larva of a stag beetle.

rows.en: “Fine. I’m done. I’m becoming a shut-in.”

ghs.en: Tomoki: "Had enough. Hikikomori now."
Sobbing and weeping tears flow out.
ghs.assessment: The English overstates quiet しくしく as full sobbing and has broken subject syntax.
ghs.remedy: Use a quiet weeping expression with a clear subject.

highlights.text: Sobbing and weeping tears flow out.

ghs.en: Miyuki: "Pushed that far..."
ghs.assessment: Pushed that far plausibly conveys being reduced to that state; the remaining issue is implied agency and fragmentary English.
ghs.remedy: Clarify the subject and agency.

highlights.text: Miyuki: "Pushed that far..."

rows.jp: 「この子もいいって言うし、その無様さに免じて今回だけは見逃してあげます」
rows.en: “Since she says it's all right, and in consideration of how pathetic you look, I'll let you off just this once.”

ghs.en: Kiri: "If the girl also says it's fine, then in deference to this unpresentable event, I will overlook things this time."
ghs.assessment: The English mislocates 無様さ, but contempt and one-time leniency both survive.
ghs.remedy: Attach the pathetic appearance to the correct target.

highlights.text: Kiri: "If the girl also says it's fine, then in deference to this unpresentable event, I will overlook things this time."

rows.jp: 「……体が動くようになったら……おぼえてろよ……霧とやら」
rows.en: “...When I can move again... you’ll pay... Kiri, or whatever your name is.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...once I'm able to move myself again...! I will not let this slide... Kiri or what was your name!"
Kiri laughed with scorn.
Kiri: "Please, feel free to."

rows.jp: 佐倉霧との出会いだった。
rows.en: That was how I met Kiri Sakura.

ghs.en:
That had been my meeting
with Sakura Kiri.
